jobs.title: Specialist - Talent Acquisition
jobs.description: ❮ back to last search Dozee Bangalore Full time Apply for this jobOverview: Dozee Health AI is a pioneer in Contactless Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM), proven to drive transformation at scale. Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, Dozee has emerged as a leader in this category. We are seeking talented individuals to help us in this very exciting journey. Candidates will be working with top healthcare providers in the country and leverage RPM's innovation to tackle healthcare's biggest challenges - from resource constraints to quality outcomes, to new care models.As our Specialist - Talent Acquisition, you will be part of Dozee’s Human Resources – Talent Acquisition team, owning Talent Acquisition & Hiring Excellence, Recruitment Operations & Process Excellence and Talent Analytics & Recruitment Technology. It is a high-ownership role for someone who brings structure, quality and pace to everything they deliver, and who wants to help save lives with Health AI.Responsibilities Independently manage sourcing, screening, and interview coordination and offer negotiation forassigned roles while assessing candidate fit. Ensure process compliance, maintain ATS workflows, coordinate stakeholders, and supportrecruitment reporting. Track recruitment metrics, leverage ATS effectively, and support data-driven hiring decisions. Ensure consistent candidate engagement, strengthen employer branding, and improve candidateexperience across hiring stages. Leverage AI tools for sourcing, screening, candidate engagement, and recruitment workflows whilevalidating AI recommendations. Requirements 1 to 5 years of relevant experience Education : Graduate / MBA in Human Resources or any related field Build effective working relationships with hiring managers and internal stakeholders. Ensure a smooth candidate journey through timely communication and coordination. Take responsibility for assigned roles and hiring timelines. Communicate proactively with candidates and hiring teams regarding progress. Apply confidentiality practices consistently during hiring processes. Align recruitment activities with functional hiring priorities. Role Expectations Work independently on assigned deliverables with minimal supervision. Own outcomes end-to-end and deliver consistent, audit-ready quality. Flag risks and blockers early and propose solutions. Contribute to process improvements and support new joiners. Uphold Dozee’s values and quality-first culture in every deliverable. Vision & Mission Save Million lives with Health AI Dozee is India’s leading AI-Powered contactless Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM) and Early Warning System (EWS). A solution that continuously monitors patients and provides early warnings of clinical deterioration, enabling timely interventions and enhancing patient safety in hospitals, nursing facilities and patient homes. A "Made in India for the World" solution, Dozee has pioneered the world’s first non-contact blood pressure monitoring system. Trusted by leading healthcare providers in India, the USA, and Africa, Dozee is transforming patient safety and care by enhancing outcomes and reducing costs. Dozee is adopted by 300+ hospitals and monitors 16000+ beds across 4 countries. Dozee has monitored over 1 Mn Patients, Delivered 35000+ Life Saving Alerts and Saved 10 Mn+ Nursing Hours. Videos - Science Behind Dozee : Ballistocardiography & Artificial Intelligence - 100 Dozee deliver 144 life saving alerts and INR 2.7 Cr of saving - Sattva Study - Dozee saves life of a mother at home - Leading Healthcare Game changers work with DozeeI - Introducing Dozee VS - Dozee Shravan - A clinical grade RPM service Dozee in News: Bloomberg - Oct 21, 2024 From AI Beds to Remote ICUs, Startups are plugging India's health Gaps News18Oct 26, 2024 Now, You Can Remotely Monitor Your Loved Ones in Hospital With Bengaluru Start-Up's 'Shravan' Analytics India MagazineOct 29, 2024 Dozee Harness AI for Personalised Patient Care ET HealthWorldSep 16, 2024 We trust AI everyday - From Google Maps to Smartphones, So why not use it to enhance patient safety in healthcare? BW healthcareworldOct 29, 2024 Dozee's AI-Powered System Predicts Patient Deterioration 16 Hours in Advance A tertiary care hospital study published in JMIR, validated Dozee’s Early Warning System (EWS), showing it identified 97% of deteriorating patients, provided alerts ~19 hours in advance, and generated 5x fewer alerts, reducing alarm fatigue and improving patient outcomes. A study at King George Medical University, Lucknow, and published in Frontiers in Medical Technology demonstrated that Dozee’s automation can potentially save 2.5 hours of nursing time per shift, improving workflow efficiency and allowing more focus on patient care. A study on remote patient monitoring in general wards published in Cureus found that 90%+ of healthcare providers reported improved care and patient safety, 74% of patients felt safer, and there was a 43% increase in time for direct patient care. Research by Sattva, an independent consulting firm, demonstrates Dozee's substantial impact: for every 100 Dozee-connected beds, it can save approximately 144 lives, reduce nurses’ time for vital checks by 80%, and decrease ICU average length of stay by 1.3 days.
